notes.title: 🎮 Second Update Notice 🎮✨
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Studio SOTT.
[h2]✨Half-Auto Mode✨ has been added to <Cheese Moon>!
[/h2]
You can now switch to Half-Auto Mode by tapping the Auto button.
[h3]In Half-Auto Mode, rabbits are summoned automatically,
but you can still control the timing of your skills manually.[/h3]

Thank you so much for always playing <Cheese Moon>!
And a huge thank you to everyone who’s left reviews and feedback! 🧀

notes.title: 🎮 Update Notice 🎮✨
notes.notes:
[h1]🎮 <Cheese Moon> Update Notice 🎮✨[/h1]

Hello from Studio Sott!
Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've added some new features to <Cheese Moon>!

[h3]🔊 Separate Volume Controls[/h3]
You can now adjust the background music and sound effects independently for a more refined audio experience!

[h3]☁️ Steam Cloud Sync Support[/h3]
Your game data can now be saved to Steam Cloud!

[h3]🌙 Low Saturation Filter for Eye Comfort[/h3]
We've added a low saturation filter to reduce eye strain during long play sessions. You can toggle it easily in the settings!

[h3]🐞 Other Bug Fixes[/h3]

We’ll continue updating the game regularly.
Thank you for playing <CheeseMoon>! 🧀
